heading: top-left
name: 左右分欄大卡片輪播（兩側露出相鄰卡片、箭頭跨在卡片邊緣）
desc: 上方靠左的標題組，下方是延伸到畫面左右邊緣的輪播：中央一張圖文左右分欄的大卡片，兩側露出被裁切的相鄰卡片，方形箭頭跨在中央卡片左右邊緣上。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方不留白，標題組貼齊區塊上緣；下方輪播卡片的底邊貼齊區塊下緣。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放次要文字（其中可含一組較大的數字）與小型文字連結，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目的輪播，延伸到畫面左右邊緣：中央完整露出一張大卡片，約佔畫面寬的六成五並水平置中，高度約半個畫面高，左右兩側各露出相鄰卡片的一部分，被畫面邊緣裁切；項目等寬、等高。兩顆方形圖示按鈕作為左右箭頭，垂直置中於卡片，各自跨在中央卡片的左緣與右緣上，壓住卡片邊緣，點擊後每次切換一個項目；輪播不自動播放，項目循環排列，任何時候左右兩側都有相鄰卡片。每個項目是一張有底色的卡片，內部分成左右兩欄，左欄約六成、右欄約四成：左欄放一張橫式主體圖，完整顯示，下方置中可放一排小方塊選項、說明文字，以及兩顆並排的切換按鈕（中間夾一個小圖示），沒有時省略；右欄靠上對齊，依序放大標題、副標、小標籤、次要文字、大數字、按鈕與小型文字連結，副標、小標籤、次要文字與小型文字連結沒有時省略，右欄最下方可放兩個直向排列的文字連結，底部和左欄最下方的元素對齊。
mobile: 輪播改為一次只露出一張卡片，卡片左右留邊、置中，高度約佔畫面高的七成，看不到相鄰卡片；左右箭頭移到卡片兩側邊緣上、靠近畫面邊緣，壓住卡片邊緣，垂直位置約在卡片中段。卡片內的左右兩欄改為單欄、置中的直向堆疊：大標題（副標接在其後同列）在最上，接著是兩顆切換按鈕，再來是主體圖、小方塊選項（可換行）、說明文字、次要文字、大數字、按鈕與小型文字連結，最下方的兩個文字連結改為橫向並排。標題組維持靠左，卡片底邊仍貼齊區塊下緣。

en.name: Split-card carousel (neighbors peeking on both sides, arrows straddling the card edges)
en.desc: A left-aligned heading group at the top, above a carousel that extends to the left and right edges of the viewport: one large card split into image and text columns in the center, cropped neighboring cards peeking in on both sides, and square arrows straddling the left and right edges of the center card.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no spacing at the top, with the heading group flush with the top edge of the section; the bottom edge of the carousel cards is flush with the bottom edge of the section. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with secondary text below (which may include a larger number) and a small text link; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a carousel of multiple items that extends to the left and right edges of the viewport: one large card is fully visible in the center, taking about 65% of the viewport width and horizontally centered, and about half a viewport tall, and part of the neighboring card peeks in on each side, cropped by the viewport edge; the items are equal in width and height. Two square icon buttons serve as the left and right arrows, vertically centered on the card, each straddling the left or right edge of the center card and overlapping that edge; clicking them switches one item at a time. The carousel does not autoplay; the items loop, so there is always a neighboring card on both sides. Each item is a card with its own background, split inside into two columns, the left about 60% and the right about 40%: the left column holds a landscape main image, shown in full, optionally followed below, centered, by a row of small square options, a caption, and two side-by-side toggle buttons with a small icon between them; omit them when there is no content. The right column is top-aligned and holds, in order, a large headline, a subheading, a label, secondary text, a large number, a button and a small text link; the subheading, label, secondary text and small text link are omitted when there is no content. The bottom of the right column may hold two text links stacked vertically, with their bottom aligned to the bottom element of the left column.
en.mobile: The carousel shows only one card at a time, centered with a margin on the left and right and about 70% of the viewport tall, and no neighboring cards are visible; the left and right arrows sit on the card's two side edges near the viewport edges, overlapping the card edges, at about the middle of the card's height. The two columns inside the card become a single, centered vertical stack: the large headline (with the subheading following it on the same line) at the top, then the two toggle buttons, then the main image, the small square options (may wrap), the caption, secondary text, the large number, the button and the small text link, with the two bottom text links placed side by side horizontally. The heading group stays left-aligned, and the bottom edge of the card stays flush with the bottom edge of the section.
